fieldValues.title: Essays carry images in a dedicated image paragraph, never through markdown
fieldValues.move: The essay package gains an image paragraph: a separate paragraph type whose image is a file attached to the repository, with alt text, an optional caption, and a small fixed set of layout options (full width or original size; left, centre or right alignment). The image is always a block and text never wraps around it. SVG is accepted only when it carries no scripts: the core refuses an unsafe SVG when it is attached, and the editor shows every image only as an image element, never as inline markup. In a normal essay paragraph a markdown image does not display, so the image paragraph is the only way an image reaches the reader. Rendering is tested in the editor and the export.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Images in other editors and record forms. Text wrap, cropping, galleries and image editing. Remote images as a source. Large media: attachments stay small. Markdown images in normal paragraphs, which stay off for now.
fieldValues.falsifier: A writer still cannot add, lay out and caption an image without help; or an image paragraph renders differently in the editor and the export; or an SVG with a script is accepted or runs; or a markdown image displays in a normal paragraph.
source_ref: srs spec: SourceDocument and attaches SourceReference (I-101, I-102), attachment_policy (I-107, I-111)
fieldValues.return_when: When writers ask for wrap or for images inside text, or for formats or sizes the set does not cover.
